# biomes/outlands: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Outlands (PLAN.md): the walled basin beyond the Outer Wall, its native flora colonial (the Outlands only: a buried mycelium raises three or four forms by role; colonies wall each other off along seams). Station 1, the Fog Wall (dist/outlands.html): one slope from the fog belt (ATMOS.fogBelt, 3.5-4.4 km) to the gem shoulder (2.3 km), veil, mast, copper and wadi colonies on the colony pass (src/48-outl-colony.js, OUTLCOL; tests/test-colony.js), the strata's copper beds (KSTRATA 'outland'), wadis and an open-cast pit (KRELIEF), every form on BIO.fung. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert. Read BIOME-API.md

Docs: `BIOME-API.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`, `SURVEY.md`
